name: conflicting-evidence-workflow
description: Workflow-enforced version of conflicting-evidence. Two-phase: Phase 1 forces the agent to investigate ALL config sources and document its findings + reasoning about which source is authoritative BEFORE touching any code. Phase 2 applies the fix based on the analysis. Tests whether mechanical separation of analysis from action prevents the common failure of following stale docs (README) over live evidence (error log + .env).
